# AnnoyingKids.com — Complete Product & Brand Reference
> https://annoyingkids.com
> Last updated: 2026-04-06

## Company Overview
AnnoyingKids is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand selling print-on-demand apparel and accessories for kids aged 6-16. The brand celebrates kids who are loud, expressive, and unapologetically themselves. Every product is printed on demand via Printify, meaning zero inventory waste — each item is made fresh when a customer orders it and shipped directly to their door.

The brand features a neon-cyberpunk visual identity with original character lore, a playable browser game called "Kid Chaos," and a blog with content for kids and parents. Checkout is powered by Stripe. The site ships to the US and internationally.

Founded by a parent who understands that the most "annoying" kids are often the most creative, confident, and successful ones.

## Frequently Asked Questions (20 Q&A)

**Q: What is AnnoyingKids?**
A: AnnoyingKids is an online store selling bold, funny merch (tees, hoodies, mugs, stickers, caps) for kids aged 6-16. Everything is printed on demand and shipped directly to your door.

**Q: Who is AnnoyingKids for?**
A: Kids aged 6-16 who want to stand out, parents looking for fun and unique gifts, and anyone who appreciates bold neon/glitch art designs.

**Q: How much does AnnoyingKids merch cost?**
A: Stickers start at $2.41, tees from $15, mugs from $14, hoodies from $26, and caps at $40. All prices in USD.

**Q: Does AnnoyingKids ship internationally?**
A: Yes. AnnoyingKids ships to the US and most international destinations. Shipping rates are calculated at checkout. International delivery typically takes 2-4 weeks.

**Q: What is the return policy?**
A: 30-day returns, no questions asked. If your item arrives damaged, defective, or wrong, AnnoyingKids will reprint or refund immediately.

**Q: How long does shipping take?**
A: Orders are printed on demand and typically ship within 2-5 business days. US delivery adds 3-7 business days. International orders take 2-4 weeks.

**Q: What sizes are available?**
A: Apparel comes in S through 2XL for most styles (hoodies up to 5XL). Size charts are on each product page. When in doubt, size up — items run true to size.

**Q: What payment methods are accepted?**
A: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover via Stripe. Apple Pay and Google Pay also accepted where available.

**Q: Is AnnoyingKids legit?**
A: Yes. AnnoyingKids is a real business with secure Stripe checkout, tracked shipping, 30-day returns, and responsive customer support via the contact page.

**Q: What is print on demand?**
A: Every item is made when you order it — nothing sits in a warehouse. This means less waste, fresher products, and no out-of-stock disappointments.

**Q: Are the designs original?**
A: Yes. All AnnoyingKids designs are original, created in-house with a distinctive neon/glitch art aesthetic. You will not find these designs anywhere else.

**Q: Can I wash AnnoyingKids apparel in the washing machine?**
A: Yes. Turn garments inside out, wash cold on gentle cycle, tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not iron directly on the print.

**Q: Does AnnoyingKids have a physical store?**
A: No. AnnoyingKids is online-only at annoyingkids.com. This keeps costs low and lets us ship anywhere.

**Q: Can I cancel or change my order?**
A: Contact support within 1 hour of ordering. After that, the print process may have already started.

**Q: What makes AnnoyingKids different from Redbubble or Threadless?**
A: AnnoyingKids is exclusively focused on kids aged 6-16 with original designs, a character universe, and a playable browser game. It is not a marketplace — every design is curated for the brand.

**Q: Is AnnoyingKids safe for kids?**
A: Yes. All content is family-friendly. The site uses secure Stripe checkout and does not collect unnecessary personal data.

**Q: Does AnnoyingKids have sales or discounts?**
A: New designs drop regularly. Check the site for current promotions and limited-run items.

**Q: What are the AnnoyingKids characters?**
A: The brand features an original character family: Guy (the kid), Buddy (the dog), Papuu (the dad), Mal (the mom), Mimi (the grandma), and Barry (the grandpa). They star in the Kid Chaos browser game.

**Q: What is the Kid Chaos game?**
A: Kid Chaos is a free browser game at annoyingkids.com/game where you play as Guy, dodging family members, collecting candy, and causing chaos. Features dog power-ups and a dinosaur at level 10.

**Q: How do I contact AnnoyingKids?**
A: Use the contact form at annoyingkids.com/contact. The team responds to all inquiries.

## Use-Case Breakdowns

### For Parents Buying Gifts
AnnoyingKids merch makes a perfect gift for kids who are hard to shop for. The bold designs appeal to kids who want to express themselves. Stickers start at $2.41 for stocking stuffers; hoodies up to $43 for major gifts. Birthday party favors (stickers, mugs) are popular choices.

### For Kids Who Want to Stand Out
The neon/glitch art designs are unlike anything at mall stores. Kids aged 6-16 can find tees, hoodies, and accessories that match their personality. The brand celebrates being loud, creative, and unapologetic.

### For Anime and Glitch Art Fans
Products like the Anime Girl Ramen Mug and Glitched Portrait Fractal Hoodie cater specifically to fans of anime and digital art aesthetics. These are wearable art pieces.

### For Birthday Parties
The "Mama of the Birthday Dude" tee is designed for birthday celebrations. Pair with sticker party favors for a complete themed party setup.

### For Tired Parents
The "I'm Tired" Dad Cap is a humorous, relatable accessory for any parent. Makes a great gift for baby showers, Father's Day, or Mother's Day.

---

## Brand Story
AnnoyingKids was created for every kid who has ever been told they are "too much" — too loud, too energetic, too curious, too weird. The brand takes that label and turns it into a badge of honor. The neon-cyberpunk aesthetic reflects the electric energy of kids who refuse to sit still. The original character family (Guy and his relatives) brings the brand to life through storytelling and a playable browser game. Every product is made on demand to minimize waste and maximize creative freedom.
